answer_1.quote: We generate events by filling in the elements of our template... generating ATOMIC inferences...

answer_2.quote: We define soft uniqueness to describe diversity of generations in a corpus... estimate entropy... with GPT-2 XL models...

answer_3.quote: We train binary classifiers (critics) for human acceptability using RoBERTa-Large...

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation with Amazon Mechanical Turk. 3 annotators rate each triple...
answer_4.guideline: Workers are presented with ATOMIC-style triples and rate acceptability with options: 'always/often', 'sometimes/likely', 'farfetched/never', 'invalid', or 'too unfamiliar to judge'.
